name: Space Debris Sweeper
description: Fast-paced space arcade game where pilots scan cosmic orbital paths for grammatical anomalies, tense errors, and punctuation debris.
learning_objectives: Mastering syntax recognition, correcting irregular verb tenses, and isolating structural syntax anomalies under timed mission conditions.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Scout the radar for drifting grammatical debris sentences. 2. Tap or click the erroneous segment within the floating asteroid. 3. Input or select the correct grammatical edit to vaporize the debris and sweep the orbital quadrant clear.

name: Alien Market Trader
description: Interactive barter and conversational simulation on extraterrestrial trading stations, challenging learners to negotiate prices, ask clarifying questions, and use polite modals.
learning_objectives: Developing spontaneous oral response patterns, mastering pragmatic politeness formulas, and expanding commercial vocabulary in spoken English.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Approach alien merchants in the outer rim trading bazaar. 2. Listen or read their trade offers and inventory conditions. 3. Formulate polite counter-proposals and ask about currency exchanges using interactive voice input or speech prompts to secure rare interstellar artifacts.

name: Acoustic Study Room
description: Binaural Lo-Fi focus lounge engineered with scientific soundscapes, Pomodoro interval timers, syllabus gateway hubs, and real-time pronunciation mic testers.
learning_objectives: Enhancing deep auditory comprehension, reinforcing phonetic intonation curves, and creating low-anxiety study spaces for sustained memory consolidation.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Select your optimal acoustic frequency (Lo-Fi beats, cosmic rain, interstellar drone). 2. Choose your target language syllabus module. 3. Activate the voice evaluation microphone to repeat native speaker audio waveforms and inspect pitch alignment accuracy.
key_features: Multi-language syllabus modules (English, Thai, Korean, Japanese)

name: Classroom Games Hub
description: Expansive arcade galaxy featuring 79+ interactive single-player and multiplayer ESL classroom games engineered for high-energy vocabulary retrieval.
learning_objectives: Accelerating active lexical retrieval, reinforcing collaborative problem solving, and boosting classroom engagement through friendly competition.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Browse the 79+ game roster by category or grammatical focus. 2. Launch single-player drill or host a room code for the entire classroom. 3. Race against the clock and peers to solve vocabulary puzzles and climb the galactic leaderboards.

name: Dynamic Flashcard Generator
description: SuperMemo-2 (SM-2) algorithm-powered spaced repetition flashcard system with high-fidelity native voice pronunciations and contextual image prompts.
learning_objectives: Optimizing long-term lexical memory through mathematically calculated review intervals and contextual visual associations.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Select or generate a thematic flashcard deck based on your target CEFR level. 2. Review the target term, contextual example, and native audio. 3. Rate your recall difficulty (Easy, Good, Hard) to schedule the next optimal spaced repetition appearance.

name: AI Storytelling Engine
description: Generative branching cosmic adventures tailored to the student's exact CEFR level where learner choices shape the plot and grammatical complexity.
learning_objectives: Expanding contextual reading comprehension, analyzing narrative discourse structures, and building active descriptive vocabulary.
target_rules: Narrative Tenses (Past Simple vs. Past Continuous)
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Choose your space explorer protagonist and starting quadrant. 2. Read through immersive, illustrated narrative chapters. 3. Make critical decisions at story crossroads that test your vocabulary and determine the survival of your expedition.

name: Dynamic Bilingual Reader
description: Dual-language reading companion that delivers interactive reading passages with one-click translations, contextual grammatical breakdowns, and smart glossaries.
learning_objectives: Developing independent reading stamina, eliminating vocabulary bottlenecks, and analyzing syntactic arrangements in authentic texts.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Select an article or literary excerpt from the cosmic library. 2. Read with optional dual-language line alignment. 3. Tap any unfamiliar word or idiom for an instant phonetic breakdown, definition, and grammar note.
key_features: Bookmark vocabulary to personal review decks

name: AI Exercise Generator
description: Instant worksheet and drill generator that creates customized grammar challenges, cloze tests, error-correction drills, and multiple-choice quizzes.
learning_objectives: Reinforcing target grammatical structures through high-repetition targeted exercises and immediate corrective feedback.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Input target topics (e.g. Present Perfect Continuous) and student grade level. 2. The AI constructs balanced exercises with multiple difficulty tiers. 3. Solve online or export printable PDF worksheets with complete answer keys.
key_features: Multi-format exercise output (Cloze, MCQ, Scrambled, Editing)
Export to PDF / Word worksheet formats

name: Exam Mode Simulator
description: High-fidelity timed testing simulator mirroring standardized ESL exams (IELTS, TOEFL, TOEIC, CEFR) with comprehensive performance analytics.
learning_objectives: Building timed exam endurance, evaluating standardized competencies, and pinpointing grammatical weaknesses before official testing.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Select your target exam standard and time limit. 2. Complete timed reading, listening, and grammar modules under strict examination conditions. 3. Receive an instant diagnostic breakdown across all four language competencies.

name: Movie Relax Studio
description: Cinema-based English immersion tool pairing short movie clips and animated shorts with synchronized dual subtitles, speed modulation, and comprehension checks.
learning_objectives: Decoding fast natural native speech, understanding cultural humor and sarcasm, and absorbing modern conversational idioms.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Choose a cinematic clip by genre and language difficulty. 2. Watch with interactive dual subtitles. 3. Pause at key dialogue moments to repeat the native lines, record your voice, and answer situational comprehension questions.

name: O-NET Test Practice
description: Specialized national examination prep module curated with authentic past test papers, item analysis, and step-by-step question breakdown strategies.
learning_objectives: Mastering standardized multiple-choice question formats, eliminating common distractor answers, and boosting national curriculum exam scores.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Select the school year and grade level (Grade 6, 9, or 12). 2. Answer official practice questions with real-time timers. 3. Inspect explanations for why each distractor choice is incorrect.

name: Teacher Classroom Tools
description: Comprehensive digital toolbox for classroom instructors featuring dynamic decibel sound meters, student team randomizers, countdown timers, and blackboard widgets.
learning_objectives: Supporting classroom management, facilitating equitable student participation, and maintaining optimal acoustic learning conditions.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Launch the tool suite on your classroom projector or interactive display. 2. Set the mic sensitivity for the noise meter to encourage quiet group work. 3. Use the space wheel randomizer to call on cadets fairly and launch group timers.

name: AI Lesson Planner
description: Intelligent syllabus architect that generates structured 50-minute lesson plans, warm-ups, presentation stages, controlled practice drills, and production tasks.
learning_objectives: Streamlining teacher preparation, aligning classroom activities with CEFR benchmarks, and ensuring pedagogically sound lesson sequencing (PPP / TBL).
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Specify grade level, class duration, and target language topic (e.g. Past Continuous for storytelling). 2. Choose teaching framework (PPP, Task-Based, or Flipped). 3. Generate a complete printable lesson plan with time allocations and teacher scripts.

name: Attendance Tracker
description: Streamlined student roll-call system featuring rapid one-tap attendance logging, absence analytics, behavior tags, and CSV export capabilities.
learning_objectives: Ensuring instructional accountability, monitoring longitudinal student presence trends, and automating daily school record keeping.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Open your assigned classroom flight deck roster. 2. Tap student avatars to toggle Present, Late, Excused, or Absent status. 3. Save attendance logs and export weekly summary reports with one click.

name: Presentation Mode Canvas
description: High-contrast, distraction-free visual presentation mode optimized for school projectors and interactive smartboards, with zoomable text and laser pointer tools.
learning_objectives: Maximizing visual clarity for whole-class instruction, minimizing digital clutter, and guiding collective reading focus.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Launch Presentation Mode from any lesson or reader page. 2. Connect to the classroom projector. 3. Use keyboard shortcuts or virtual pointers to highlight key grammar rules and lead whole-class choral reading.
key_features: Virtual laser pointer and highlighter overlay

name: Custom Rubrics Generator
description: Rubric creation engine that produces transparent, multi-tiered criteria for evaluating speaking presentations, creative essays, and collaborative group tasks.
learning_objectives: Establishing explicit performance criteria, providing objective feedback, and demystifying subjective language grading for students.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Select the assessment format (Speaking presentation, Essay, Roleplay dialogue). 2. Adjust evaluation dimensions and performance bands (Beginning, Developing, Proficient, Advanced). 3. Export student-friendly grading sheets or rubrics.
key_features: Instant PDF export for classroom handouts

name: Students Record Hub
description: Centralized student dossier housing longitudinal academic grades, attendance logs, teacher anecdotal notes, and CEFR competency milestones.
learning_objectives: Tracking individual learner growth over time, identifying micro-learning gaps, and building comprehensive language progress portfolios.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Select a cadet from your roster to open their personal flight file. 2. View historical quiz performances, XP gains, and attendance rates. 3. Add private progress notes and generate parent-teacher consultation summaries.

name: Tutor Marketplace
description: Global directory connecting eager ESL learners with certified native teachers and peer study buddies for 1-on-1 video lessons, conversation practice, and exam prep.
learning_objectives: Building real-time oral fluency, receiving individualized native speaker feedback, and building cultural communicative competence.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Filter verified tutors by native accent, hourly availability, and specialization (Business English, IELTS, Conversational). 2. View tutor introduction videos and student ratings. 3. Book a live practice flight and launch the interactive video room.
key_features: Verified tutor profiles with video intros
In-app whiteboard and lesson materials sync

name: Roleplay Workspace
description: Dynamic scenario simulator placing students into real-life communicative challenges (Airport customs, job interviews, emergency room, alien diplomacy).
learning_objectives: Practicing pragmatic English for authentic high-stakes situations, reducing hesitation, and mastering register (formal vs. casual).
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Choose your simulation scenario and assigned character role. 2. Converse with AI or peer characters using spoken or typed prompts. 3. Successfully accomplish the objective (e.g. catch your connecting flight or negotiate a peace treaty) to win XP.
key_features: AI interactive dialog partner with voice responses

name: English Lounge
description: Safe, moderated community hub where global cadets gather to share daily study journals, discuss English idioms, participate in debates, and practice writing.
learning_objectives: Encouraging authentic peer-to-peer communicative writing, fostering international cultural exchange, and sustaining long-term motivation.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Join daily discussion topics or create your own study thread. 2. Post thoughtful reflections in English and reply to international classmates. 3. Earn community badges for helpful comments and language insights.
key_features: Daily topic prompts curated by educators
Integrated dictionary look-up on all posts

name: Homework Hub
description: Digital homework locker allowing teachers to dispatch reading tasks, grammar worksheets, and audio recordings, while students track deadlines and submit responses.
learning_objectives: Fostering autonomous study habits, completing structured after-class reinforcement, and tracking submission timeliness.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Inspect your flight calendar for pending homework missions. 2. Complete the assigned interactive exercises or upload voice recordings. 3. Submit your work and review personalized teacher corrections once marked.
key_features: Direct teacher feedback and red-pen annotations

name: Global Job Matcher
description: International job board connecting certified ESL instructors with international schools, online tutoring platforms, and corporate training institutions worldwide.
learning_objectives: Navigating international ESL employment opportunities, preparing professional resumes, and practicing English job interview questions.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Filter global vacancies by country, school tier, visa sponsorship, and salary. 2. Build your teacher portfolio dossier with verified credentials. 3. Apply directly to school directors and track interview invitations.

name: English Wisdom Quotes
description: Daily dose of inspiring global literature and philosophical quotes accompanied by deep etymological dissections, idiomatic breakdowns, and pronunciation guides.
learning_objectives: Appreciating English literary nuance, expanding figurative language competence, and memorizing memorable quotes for essay writing.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Reveal today's featured wisdom quote and author background. 2. Listen to the dramatic voice delivery. 3. Explore the idiomatic dissection and share your favorite quotes with fellow cadets.
key_features: Audio voice narration with cadence controls

name: Command Dashboard
description: The nerve center of your LingoLandVerse odyssey. Displays active mission streaks, SuperMemo-2 Smart Review Asteroids, cosmic XP tallies, and flight deck telemetry.
learning_objectives: Maintaining daily habit consistency, organizing targeted review tasks, and monitoring comprehensive language level progression.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Log in to your pilot station to view today's incoming asteroids. 2. Complete daily study missions to fuel your flight streak. 3. Monitor your global ranking and collect star badges across subject galaxies.
key_features: Daily streak fuel meter with freeze protection
Quick-launch shortcuts to all active courses

name: Lingo-Pet Hatchery
description: Adopt and nurture an adorable cosmic companion (Astro-Paws, Star-Fox, Nebula-Cat) whose evolution, health, and joy directly depend on your daily English practice.
learning_objectives: Building positive emotional associations with language practice, preventing study burnout, and rewarding persistent effort.
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Hatch your cosmic companion from a starlight egg. 2. Earn food pellets and evolution crystals by completing reading drills and vocabulary flashcards. 3. Watch your companion grow new cosmic forms as your fluency expands.
key_features: Visual evolution stages tied to CEFR milestones
Interactive pet animations and voice reactions
Floating companion widget that cheers on your study

name: Language Modules
description: Comprehensive CEFR-mapped syllabus pathways guiding students systematically from absolute beginner (A1) through native-level mastery (C2) with interactive units.
learning_objectives: Providing structured, scaffolding-based mastery of all foundational English language systems (Phonology, Morphology, Syntax, Semantics).
how_to_play: Step-by-step instructions: 1. Select your target language syllabus (English, Thai, Korean, Japanese). 2. Complete structured module lessons combining listening, grammar discovery, and quizzes. 3. Pass cumulative stage gates to unlock intermediate and advanced tiers.
key_features: Multi-language curriculum support (English, Thai, Japanese, Korean)
Structured A1 to C2 unit progression
